capabilities: : Reload open note on external change
extras: Warning: If you are typing in a note while another program changes the same file, the outside change wins and your last unsaved keystrokes can be lost.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that reloads the open note when another program changes it on disk.
motivation: To ensure the open note reflects changes made by other programs, especially on network drives and sync folders.
problem: Obsidian may not automatically detect changes made to a note file by external programs when the vault is stored on network drives or certain sync folders.
summary: A plugin that reloads the currently open Obsidian note when the file is modified by an external program, useful for network drives and sync folders.
